form:FormGroup.label: Key Type
form:FormGroup.helpText: The data type used to store keys. Fixed-size types (Boolean to Double) are compact; String allows up to 511 bytes; the lookup table types de-duplicate keys to save space at some cost to speed; Variable stores short keys directly and longer ones in a lookup table; Tags stores sets of name=value tags. Default is Variable.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Fixed-size types are compact; lookup tables are smaller but slower. Default is Variable.

form:FormGroup.label: Hash Length
form:FormGroup.helpText: The size of the hash used by the Hash lookup table and Variable types: Integer (4 bytes) or Long (8 bytes). Only enabled for those types. Default is Integer.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Integer (4 bytes) or Long (8 bytes); only used by hash lookup and Variable types.

form:FormGroup.label: Temporal Precision
form:FormGroup.helpText: How precisely the time of each entry is stored, from Day down to Nanosecond. Coarser precision uses less space. Default is Millisecond.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: From Day to Nanosecond; coarser uses less space. Default is Millisecond.
